name: MangaDex
author: MoeGame
licenseNote: Self-authored rule. MangaDex (mangadex.org) public JSON API v5; search/detail/chapters/at-home image server all implemented.
search: function search(kw, page) { try { var p = page || 1; var url = 'https://api.mangadex.org/manga?title=' + encodeURIComponent(kw) + '&limit=20&offset=' + ((p - 1) * 20) + '&includes[]=cover_art'; return fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'moeplay/0.20.0' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return []; var data = JSON.parse(r.body); var list = data.data || []; return list.map(function(it) { var coverUrl = ''; var rels = it.relationships || []; for (var i = 0; i < rels.length; i++) { if (rels[i].type === 'cover_art' && rels[i].attributes) { coverUrl = 'https://uploads.mangadex.org/covers/' + it.id + '/' + rels[i].attributes.fileName; break; } } var t = (it.attributes && it.attributes.title) || {}; var title = t.en || t['ja'] || t['zh'] || t['ja-ro'] || it.id; return { title: title, url: 'https://mangadex.org/title/' + it.id, cover: coverUrl, extra: { id: it.id } }; }); }).catch(function(e) { throw new Error('mangadex search: ' + e.message); }); } catch (e) { throw new Error('mangadex search: ' + e.message); } }
detail: function detail(url) { try { var m = /mangadex\.org\/title\/([a-f0-9-]+)/.exec(url || ''); if (!m) return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; var id = m[1]; return fetch('https://api.mangadex.org/manga/' + id + '?includes[]=cover_art', { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'moeplay/0.20.0' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return { title: id, cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; var d = JSON.parse(r.body); var attrs = d.data && d.data.attributes; if (!attrs) return { title: id, cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; var t = attrs.title || {}; var desc = attrs.description || {}; var coverUrl = ''; var rels = (d.data.relationships) || []; for (var i = 0; i < rels.length; i++) { if (rels[i].type === 'cover_art' && rels[i].attributes) { coverUrl = 'https://uploads.mangadex.org/covers/' + id + '/' + rels[i].attributes.fileName; break; } } var title = t.en || t['ja'] || t['zh'] || id; var description = desc.en || desc['ja'] || desc['zh'] || ''; return { title: title, cover: coverUrl || null, description: description || null, extra: {} }; }).catch(function() { return { title: id, cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; }); } catch (e) { return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; } }
chapter: function chapter(detailUrl) { try { var m = /mangadex\.org\/title\/([a-f0-9-]+)/.exec(detailUrl || ''); if (!m) return []; var id = m[1]; return fetch('https://api.mangadex.org/manga/' + id + '/feed?translatedLanguage[]=en&translatedLanguage[]=zh&order[chapter]=asc&limit=500', { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'moeplay/0.20.0' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return []; var d = JSON.parse(r.body); var list = d.data || []; return list.map(function(ch) { var a = ch.attributes || {}; var num = a.chapter || ''; var title = a.title ? (a.title + ' ') : ''; return { id: ch.id, title: ('第' + num + '话 ' + title).trim(), url: 'https://mangadex.org/chapter/' + ch.id, index: parseInt(num, 10) || 0 }; }); }).catch(function() { return []; }); } catch (e) { return []; } }
parse: function parse(chapterUrl) { try { var m = /mangadex\.org\/chapter\/([a-f0-9-]+)/.exec(chapterUrl || ''); if (!m) return { urls: [], kind: 'images' }; var id = m[1]; return fetch('https://api.mangadex.org/at-home/server/' + id, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'moeplay/0.20.0' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return { urls: [], kind: 'images' }; var d = JSON.parse(r.body); var base = d.baseUrl; var ch = d.chapter; if (!base || !ch) return { urls: [], kind: 'images' }; var files = ch.data || []; var urls = []; for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) { urls.push(base + '/data/' + ch.hash + '/' + files[i]); } return { urls: urls, kind: 'images' }; }).catch(function() { return { urls: [], kind: 'images' }; }); } catch (e) { return { urls: [], kind: 'images' }; } }
